version.changelog: OpenClaw sessions_spawn direct delegation; remove shared payload-builder guidance and stale orchestration state.

llm.summary: This skill is coherent for Notion-backed memory, but it can persist sensitive mood, journal, identity, and profile data locally and in Notion without clear consent or retention controls.

dimensions.detail: The environment access is mostly purpose-aligned, but ambient recall reads workspace memory, dream, journal, and Notion sources and may print recalled content, paths, IDs, or URLs to stdout, which is broader than a user may expect for quiet continuity context.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is simple and disclosed: Node is required, Notion auth is required, notion-api-automation is a dependency, and no third-party npm packages are installed by this artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill instructs proactive USER.md profile promotion and routine Notion writes for personal state and journal data, but does not require explicit user confirmation before storing or externalizing sensitive derived facts.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill creates durable Notion records, local memory mirrors, staged ambient recall files, and proactive profile updates, but it lacks clear retention, deletion, minimization, and first-use consent guidance.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The scripts and instructions match the stated purpose: durable memory, emotion/state tracking, journaling, ambient recall, and identity/profile continuity using local workspace files and Notion databases.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Use this only if you intentionally want an agent to keep durable memory in Notion and local workspace files. Review the Notion workspace permissions, set NOTIONCTL_PATH only to a trusted local notionctl script, avoid storing secrets or highly sensitive personal data, and periodically inspect or delete USER.md, memory files, and the Notion databases it creates.
llm.findings:
[SDI-2] expected: The NOTIONCTL_PATH override is a disclosed compatibility escape hatch for locating notionctl, but it does let an environment-selected local script execute with the agent's privileges, so users should only set it to a trusted path.
[SQP-2] expected: Persisting long-term memory, state, emotion, and journal content to Notion is central to the skill, but the artifact does not clearly warn about third-party cloud retention or require consent before external writes.
[SQP-2] expected: USER.md profile promotion is purpose-aligned and has some limits against secrets and intimate data, but it is proactive and lacks an explicit notice or approval step before modifying a durable user profile.
[SQP-2] expected: Caller-specified write paths in local helper scripts support inspectable artifacts, but the scripts do not confine outputs to a dedicated memory directory.
[SQP-2] expected: Ambient recall is part of the skill's continuity design, but returning recalled content and source metadata on stdout can expose private memory content through logs or tool transcripts.
